en.html:
After seeing this, who could still doubt that the world was ending?
Who would look at it and say, no, bhai, this is one temporary difficulty, everything will be becoming normal?

Fuji's beautiful shape was gone. Lava poured from it like thick, dirty blood.
Here, nothing was allowed to live. Nothing allowed to continue. Nothing new allowed to come into being. Ruin only; everything else refused. The whole world reduced to one answer, and that answer was NO.

Who was supposed to live here?
Who COULD live here?

en.html:
Hikaru"Hikaru respects history. So I shall follow the road it shows. However much fighting power I possess, first let the world see the RESULTS. Until then, no claiming a title I have not earned!"
Hikaru"And no repeating their mistakes, either!"
Hikaru"All those old conquerors went rotten halfway. Before every human being in the world was conquered, they became satisfied. Drowned themselves in their own power. Gods with the work still unfinished!"
Hikaru"And that is why they were overthrown..."
Hikaru"I will not do that. The road of conquest, I will walk to the very end."
Hikaru"Hikaru Minato will challenge all three hundred crore human beings and make every one of them submit. THEN, on that achievement, I shall take the seat of God!"
Kageaki"Whatever happens, you will not let go of this delusion?!"
Hikaru"I CANNOT! Delusion, yes! Stupidity, yes! Call it what it is! This one thought is what keeps Hikaru alive!"
Hikaru"First, let us prepare the stage. This ridiculous power inside me... there is enough to share with everybody under heaven!"
Kageaki"—WHAT are you—?!"
Hikaru"For one personal wish, Hikaru demands the defeat and death of all humanity. Then humanity must have the means to resist and reject me. Otherwise where is the FAIRNESS?"
Hikaru"So I grant it! The law of martial power! The strength and the will to kill, to fight, to seize!"
Hikaru"MARTIAL RULE BENEATH HEAVEN! HERE AND NOW, HIKARU MINATO DECREES IT!!"

光「光は歴史への敬意のもと、その示す道筋に 従おう。 　いかに大きな武力を持とうが、成果を世に 顕すまでは決して僭称すまい！」
光「そして過ちの轍も踏むまい！」
光「かつての覇王は皆、中途で堕落した。 　世界人類悉くを征服する前に満足し、力に 溺れ、不完全な神となった」
光「ゆえに打倒された……」
光「おれは、そうはならぬ。 　覇道の終端までを踏破する」
光「湊斗光は三〇億人類全てと勝負し屈服させ、 その事実をもって神座へ至ろう！」
景明「お前は、どうしても、 　その妄念を捨てられないのか!?」
光「捨てられぬ！ 　いかにも妄念、いかにも愚念、されどこの 一念が光の命脈！」
光「まずは舞台を整えよう。 　今、光に宿るこの戯けた力……天下万民と 分かち合うにも充分だ！」
景明「――――何を!?」
光「光は一身の願いから全人類の敗死を求む。 　ならば諸人もろびとは光の意思に抗い拒絶するため の能を持たなくてはなるまい――でなくては 不公正・・・！」
光「ゆえに授ける！ 　武の一法！　殺伐争奪の力と心を！」
光「天下布武ッッ!! 　今ここに、湊斗光が発令した!!」

Hikaru"...That question also, I have answered before."

Hikaru"With that, I will be satisfied."

en.html:
I thought of threads.

A whole bundle, tangled together. Pull this one and that one tightens. Try that side and the first knot acquires children. Eventually you cannot even remember what the threads looked like before they made this lifelong commitment to ruining one another.

To untangle it properly, you would sit with it. Give it time. Find where each thread went, gently work it loose. Haan. That would be the proper way.

But suppose there was no time?

Then all that patience, all that understanding—what would I do with it? Stand here being a very understanding man while the world ended?

One method remained.
Take scissors. Cut.

Cut through the knot and set the threads free.

For this tangle, now, nothing else remained.

糸の存在を想う。

　絡まり合った糸の束。
　複雑過ぎて、何処がどうしてこうなったのか、最早
まるでわからない。

　これを解きほぐすなら、時間を掛けて取り組むのが
正しいやり方だろう。
　
　だが、その時間が無ければ――

　手段は一つだ。
　鋏を使って切るしかない。

　結び目を断ち切って、糸を解放するしかない。
　
　この絡まりを解くには、もうそれしか。
